verses.1: May Solomon, son of wisdom, bring joy to his father. And may the foolish child bring sorrow to his mother.
verses.2: Evil deeds cannot be effective; righteousness alone can save from death.
verses.3: The LORD will not exhaust the soul of the righteous, but the souls of the wicked will be destroyed.
verses.4: The head makes the hand into a hammer; and the fingers become tools for working.
verses.5: The foolish son of a wise man became sick during the harvest. The son of a proud man also became sick.
verses.6: Blessed be the head of the righteous, and may the mouth of the wicked be covered with shame.
verses.7: The righteous shall be remembered with blessings, while the names of the wicked will be forgotten.
verses.8: A wise heart will take the commandment, and the words of the mouth will be spoken.
verses.9: He who walks in the dark will surely stumble and lose his way.
verses.10: The crow’s eye will bring sorrow; the fox’s mouth will cry out in pain.
verses.11: The life of the righteous and that of the wicked will be covered by darkness.
verses.12: Hate will bring about chaos and destruction. But love will cover up all sins.
verses.13: In the words of Nabon, one can find wisdom and guidance for those who lack compassion.
verses.14: Wise men expect knowledge from their lips, while the wild boar’s mouth speaks with arrogance.
verses.15: Hon was rich; his wealth made him able to help those in need.
verses.16: The action of the righteous leads to life; the actions of the wicked lead to destruction.
verses.17: It shelters those who keep their promises and depart from those who are harmful.
verses.18: He who covers the lips of lies and reveals deceit is indeed foolish.
verses.19: In many cases, sin never stops, and the wickedness in their words continues.
verses.20: Gold is chosen for the mouth of a righteous person, but for the wicked it’s like dust.
verses.21: The lips of the righteous will cause many to sin; they will die in a heartless manner.
verses.22: By the blessing of Jehovah, she will be wealthy, and no sorrow will be associated with her.
verses.23: When one acts foolishly, it brings no benefit or wisdom to that person.
verses.24: The wickedness of the evil person will bring destruction upon them, while the righteousness of the righteous will bring blessings.
verses.25: After death, neither the wicked nor the righteous will be distinguished from each other forever.
verses.26: It’s like fire for the eyes; it’s also like smoke for them. It makes them unable to see properly.
verses.27: The fear of Jehovah will add days and years to the lives of the wicked.
verses.28: The joy of the righteous will be multiplied, but the sorrow of the wicked will be destroyed.
verses.29: It is necessary to follow the path of Jehovah, and to do what is right.
verses.30: The righteous will dwell forever in peace, but the wicked will not be allowed to settle on this earth.
verses.31: The righteous will be filled with wisdom, and their lips will speak truthfully.
verses.32: The lips of the righteous will express desire, while the mouths of the wicked will be filled with deceit.
